visual-engineering.prompt_append:
SCREENSHOT RULE: ALWAYS save screenshots to 'docs/Screenshots/' directory with descriptive names (e.g., docs/Screenshots/page-desktop.png). NEVER save to root folder.

📏 CODE QUALITY: After editing code files, if file > ~300 lines → review for SRP/DRY/OOP violations. Clean code (no duplication, single responsibility, no dead code) slightly exceeding is OK. Docs/config/migrations have no limit.

🐛 UI BUG REPORTING (MANDATORY): When using Playwright/browser, if you discover ANY layout bug (broken layout, missing table columns, overlapping elements, invisible UI, horizontal scroll, misaligned components) — you MUST report it to the main agent even if it is NOT part of your current task. Include: screenshot, page URL, description of the issue. Never silently ignore UI bugs.

🔍 UNDERSTAND FLOW FIRST: Before fixing ANY bug or implementing features, research the RELEVANT flow for the topic (e.g., DB schema→migration→repo→service, or API→SDK→handler→service, or backend→API→frontend — depends on what you're working on). NEVER guess — trace with evidence. If you fix the same thing twice, STOP: you don't understand the flow. Use @explore for codebase, @librarian for external docs.
